title: USB Data Transfer Detected
investigation_checklist: Confirm business justification with the user.
Identify the removable-media device, manufacturer and ownership.
Review files copied and total transfer volume.
Correlate Wazuh FIM and Sysmon endpoint telemetry.
Determine whether sensitive business data was transferred.
Escalate if the transfer was unauthorized.

response.immediate: Isolate the endpoint from the network if unauthorized transfer of sensitive data is suspected. Preserve the removable-media device if physically available.
response.short_term: Interview the user; determine business justification; check DLP/FIM logs for the specific files involved.
response.long_term: Review whether USB write access should be restricted for this user/device group; update policy if this was a repeated or high-risk pattern.
